name: Wachau Cultural Landscape
description: The Wachau is a 36-kilometre stretch of the Danube valley in Lower Austria, running between Melk and Krems. Steep terraced vineyards climb above villages, with monasteries, castles and ruins on the slopes, and settlement here goes back to prehistoric times. Visitors come for the wine and for Dürnstein's castle ruin, where King Richard I of England was once held captive.
